# General Information: Help & Legend

This page consolidates navigation guidance and legend information for using this clinical decision support system.

## Navigation Legend

- **Combined Tab**: Primary guidance mode (default view)
- **InPatient (Inpt)**: Inpatient-specific recommendations
- **Outpatient (Outpt)**: Outpatient setting recommendations
- **ER/UC (ERUC)**: Emergency department and urgent care guidance
